treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Republic of Malta and the Government of the Republic of Kosovo for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2019)
eif_quote: [S.L. 123.192, L.N. 168 of 2019, art. 2(c)] that the Convention has entered into force on 20th September, 2019. || [Art. 27(2)(a)] with regard to taxes withheld at source in respect of amounts paid or credited on or after the first day of January following the date upon which this Convention enters into force
source_title: Malta S.L. 123.192 Double Taxation Relief (Taxes on Income) (The Government of the Republic of Kosovo) Order (L.N. 168 of 2019), Schedule: Convention text

rates.quote: (a) where the dividends are paid by a company which is a resident of Kosovo to a resident of Malta who is the beneficial owner thereof, the tax so charged in Kosovo shall not exceed: (i) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends throughout a 365 day period that includes the day of the payment of the dividend (...)
(ii) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases;

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.basis: treaty art. 26(1) (Entitlement to benefits - principal purpose test)
ppt.quote: 1. Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that results directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Dividends are asymmetric: Kosovo-source dividends capped at 0% (company, >=10% capital, 365 days) / 10% (source_state XK). Malta-source dividends: Art. 10(2)(b) "Malta tax on the gross amount of the dividends shall not exceed that chargeable on the profits out of which the dividends are paid" (Malta imputation system; no numeric percentage cap) - not modelled as a rate. Interest taxable only in residence State (Art. 11(3)) when paid on credit sales of equipment/merchandise/services, on any bank loan, to a collective investment scheme, to the other State/central bank/local authority, or on intercompany loans - not modelled as plain tiers. Signed Prishtina 6 March 2019 (English and Albanian; English prevails). ATK summary table shows 0/10% for all three categories - conflicts with interest 5% (exemptions aside) and royalties exclusive. Kosovo is not an MLI party; treaty-own PPT Art. 26.
